name: Wisdomball Q10 Hold the Anchors: abandoning and taking the quest again sends an escorting Khadgar back to the camp with his gossip (#12842, #12866)
contract: Khadgar 9417004 (guid 9417100, map 4418, phase 4) starts escort path 94171000 from the camp gossip 9417006 and
clears his npcflags while escorting; the C++ wait helper stops him once no player is within 25 yd. Accepting
Hold the Anchors 9417110 while he escorts or channels, with no other Q10 holder within 25 yd of him, makes the
C++ wisdomball_anchors_escort_reset despawn his wave mobs and him; he respawns at the camp after his 30 s spawn
DISCRIMINATING: after start -> abandon -> accept again, he is back within 8 yd of the camp spot and offers the
escort gossip again; without the reset he stays where the escort stopped, with no gossip.
